feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: NBA eyes slam dunk with multibillion dollar fund to woo football giants
articles.summary: The US National Basketball Association (NBA) is drawing up plans for a multibillion dollar infrastructure fund to help convince some of Europe's top football clubs to back its vision for the sport's expansion.

articles.title: 'Bring Jensen back': Petition to reinstate Huang gathers pace
articles.summary: A petition demanding the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia boss has reached 175,000 signatures including more than 8,700 staff, according to organisers.

articles.title: Company caught up in Nvidia controversy launches internal investigation
articles.summary: A cloud computing company facing scrutiny over claims involving tech giant Nvidia has launched an internal investigation conducted by external lawyers.

articles.title: Savings app Chip targets retail investors in private market first
articles.summary: A British tech company is offering retail investors the chance to buy its shares in a first for the new private securities market that the London Stock Exchange (LSE) hopes will encourage more fast-growing scale-ups to remain in the UK.

articles.title: Microsoft confirms all services are restored after global outage
articles.summary: Microsoft has said that all services have been fully restored after a global outage which affected the NHS, police, schools and other services across the UK.

articles.title: Business secretary to hold further talks with Poundland owners amid rescue talks
articles.summary: Jonathan Reynolds, the business secretary, is to hold further talks with Poundland's owner and its management team amid a race to save the discount retailer from collapse.

articles.title: Thames Water creditors offer £75m social tariff boost to win over Burnham
articles.summary: Thames Water creditors will establish a £75m fund for vulnerable customers as part of a package designed to win Andy Burnham’s support for a private sector rescue of the company and avert its nationalisation.

articles.title: Go Compare owner Future eyes sale of business arm
articles.summary: The London-listed company which owns Go Compare, the price comparison platform, is exploring a sale of its business-to-business arm.

articles.title: Elliott spreads out with interest in KKR-backed Flora Food Group
articles.summary: The American investment firm Elliott Management is circling Flora Food Group, the spreads and margarines producer, amid signs that its owner is struggling to convince bidders to meet a €7bn (£5.8bn) asking price.

articles.title: FBI seizes $1.2bn stolen in Binance cryptocurrency hack
articles.summary: The FBI has seized more than $1.2bn (£910m) of cryptocurrency stolen from Binance last month.
